summary: You take six courses from the list, at most three of them quantum mechanics or quantum field theory, each for at least 3 units and a letter grade of B+ or better. If the six come to fewer than 20 units, more Physics or Applied Physics courses of 3+ units make up the rest. Your 3.3 GPA and the Graduate Study Committee's approval of your course program are checked by hand.

program.why: Grading: "All courses taken towards the PhD Minor must be taken for at least 3 units and receive a grade of B+ or higher."

JGIQmDLY.why: "Doctoral students seeking a minor in Physics must take at least six courses from the list below for 20 units. Courses must be taken for a letter grade." The 20 units are the program's unit minimum, which the extra Physics or Applied Physics courses below can complete. Grading: "at least 3 units". Notes: "You may only count up to 3 of the following courses towards the Ph.D. minor: PHYSICS230 ... PHYSICS231 ... PHYSICS234 ... PHYSICS330 ... PHYSICS331 ... PHYSICS332"
